classification.difficultyReason: Apply the preceding quadratic-model method to population and rates, connect a stationary time to a maximum population, and reject the negative root when finding elimination time.

content.prompt:
An infestation of ants hit a Year 7’s locker but was gradually brought under control.

The ant population $P$, in hundreds, $t$ hours after it was discovered, is $P(t)=7+6t-t^2$.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the initial population of the ants.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}P(0)&=7+6(0)-(0)^2\\&=7\text{ hundred ants}\end{align*}$$
The initial population was $700$ ants.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the initial rate at which the population was changing.

answer.short: $6$ hundred ants per hour ($600$ ants per hour), increasing.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}P'(t)&=6-2t\\P'(0)&=6-2(0)\\&=6\text{ hundred ants per hour}\end{align*}$$
Initially, the population was increasing by $600$ ants per hour.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the rate at which the ant population is changing after 4 hours.

answer.short: $-2$ hundred ants per hour; decreasing by $200$ ants per hour.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}P'(t)&=6-2t\\P'(4)&=6-2(4)\\&=-2\text{ hundred ants per hour}\end{align*}$$
After $4$ hours, the population was decreasing by $200$ ants per hour.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Find when the ant population was at its maximum.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}P'(t)&=0\\6-2t&=0\\t&=3\text{ hours}\end{align*}$$
The quadratic opens downwards, so this stationary point is a maximum.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Find the maximum population of the ants.

answer.worked:
The maximum occurs at $t=3$ hours.
$$\begin{align*}P(3)&=7+6(3)-3^2\\&=16\text{ hundred ants}\end{align*}$$
The maximum population was $1600$ ants.

children.label: f
children.prompt: When were the ants finally eliminated?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}P(t)&=0\\7+6t-t^2&=0\\t^2-6t-7&=0\\(t-7)(t+1)&=0\\t&=-1\text{ or }7\end{align*}$$
Reject $t=-1$ because time is measured after discovery. The ants were eliminated after $7$ hours.
